create.name: Chloë Goodchild
create.bio:
Chloë Goodchild is a British singer, voice teacher and author who founded The Naked Voice in 1990, followed by its charitable foundation in 2004. Her work treats the voice as a path of self-inquiry: through spoken, sung and silent practice, students learn to listen deeply, find their own authentic voice and communicate with compassion. She writes and records sung meditations and mantras on her own Naked Voice label.

She teaches through online courses, one-to-one Voiceline sessions and in-person gatherings called Singing Fields, and leads Spirit of Now, a monthly online sound community. Naked Voice facilitators are trained through a mentored apprenticeship of at least two years. Her books include The Naked Voice: Transform Your Life through the Power of Sound and Awakening Through Sound, a Sounds True programme of practices. She hosts the VOCE Dialogues podcast and has taught a series of self-paced and live voice courses on The Shift Network.

books.title: The Naked Voice: Transform Your Life through the Power of Sound
books.author: Chloë Goodchild
books.description: Chloë Goodchild's account of her own journey with the voice and the practices of The Naked Voice. It guides readers through spoken, sung and silent exercises for finding and trusting their authentic voice.

books.title: Awakening Through Sound: The Naked Voice Program to Access Your Deepest Wisdom
books.author: Chloë Goodchild
books.description: A Sounds True programme of guided vocal practices drawn from The Naked Voice, with recordings to sing along with. It moves through deep listening, sounding and silence as a daily practice.

courses.title: Spirit of Now: A Community of Sound
courses.description: A monthly online sound community led by Chloë, with a two-hour live Zoom session each month, recordings and a private members' group. A higher Co-Creator tier (£45 GBP per month) adds quarterly classes.

courses.title: Your Sovereign Voice: Awakening the Music of Your Soul
courses.description: A weekend residential retreat with Chloë at Hawkwood College near Stroud, Gloucestershire. It brings together voice practice, deep listening and silence.

courses.title: Naked Voice Facilitator Training
courses.description: A mentored training of at least two years in three stages (foundation student, trainee and apprentice), leading to graduation as a Naked Voice facilitator. Applicants begin with an application form and a Voiceline session with Chloë.

courses.title: Find Your Naked Voice (Download)
courses.description: A downloadable programme of Chloë's core Naked Voice practices for working with the voice at home.

courses.title: Empower Your Inner Voice of Silence
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course of weekly meditations, breathing exercises, sound practices and energy movement centred on the presence of silence.

courses.title: The Art of Loving Your Voice
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced course working with the Seven Sacred Sounds of Love. It uses the voice to loosen self-limiting beliefs and support authentic expression.

courses.title: Your Vocal Impulse
courses.description: A seven-module recorded course that uses the sound of your own voice to work with difficult emotions and old personal narratives.

courses.title: The Vocal Impulse Advanced Practicum
courses.description: A fourteen-module recorded practicum that introduces seven musical modes and the emotional tones they carry, as a deeper practice of authentic vocal expression.

courses.title: The Sounds of Your Soul
courses.description: A seven-module recorded course of simple vocal practices that sound seven 'tonal energies' of the soul.
